input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision in the Agreement. Each renewal term is one year, which is acceptable, but the sole exit is 90 days' written notice, i.e. a 90-day non-renewal notice window that fails the 60-day fallback ceiling on a material term (though not itself walk-away). The Agreement grants no renewal price-uplift right, since Section 3.1 fixes consideration as a 30% share of Net Sales, so the price-cap element is not triggered. We therefore target the fallback and reset the window to 60 days in advance, retaining the mutual either-Party structure, the one-year renewal term and the "Termination Date" definition. The preferred 30-day opt-out plus a 60-day vendor reminder is a rationale note only.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.summary: Reset the Section 4.1 non-renewal notice window to 60 days in advance.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The one-year term auto-renews annually but could only be exited on 90 days' notice, so we have reset the non-renewal notice window to 60 days in advance, which is our fallback position (we would prefer 30 days with a 60-day renewal reminder).

ops.oldText: upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: upon written notice to the other given at least 60 days in advance
